text:
emily: Quick follow-up from yesterday's OOM postmortem — two parallel remediation paths: profiler exports for hot allocation stacks, and a soft-eviction / GC guard. I'll dump owners + deadlines here.

sanjay: I can take profiler export. Prototype that streams pprof-like snapshots to S3 by EOD Thu. Need format agreement.

kevin: I'll own the soft-eviction guard and canary rollout. Plan: canary on shard-12 next Tue (50% traffic) then full Wed.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary/shard-12 deployment scheduled by kevin @2800012350. Status: queued.

olivia: For profiler export: include per-shard KV residency histograms so we can correlate fragmentation -> OOM.

marco: @sanjay yes — add per-shard residency buckets + slot-age tag. Metrics pipeline can ingest that.

lisa: Also please capture a tiny sampled set of allocation stack traces (top-10 sites). 1% sampling should keep overhead low.

emily: Owners & timelines (summarized):
- sanjay -> profiler export (S3 prototype) by 2800070000 (Thu EOD)
- lisa -> sampling traces instrumentation by 2800030000 (Mon)
- kevin -> soft-eviction canary start 2800012350 (now) and full rollout by 2800080000 (Wed)
- marco -> metrics ingestion schema + dashboard by 2800020000

sanjay: Implementation note: we'll emit streaming snapshots + histograms. Example pseudocode:
```
heapprof.dump(stream=True, tags=["shard","slot_age"]) -> s3://redwood-kv-profiles/${ts}.pb
```
I'll ensure artifacts are KMS-encrypted and lifecycle TTL applied.

kevin: Can we set a temporary hard-limit guard: trigger soft-eviction at 90% residency to avoid full OOM while iterating?

olivia: +1. ops, please add alert: "shard_residency >= 90% for 1m" -> pager eng-runtime-oncall.

ops-bot: alert-manager: rule created: shard_residency_high. Threshold 90% x 60s. Pager: eng-runtime-oncall.

marco: I'll add a dashboard panel correlating residency, kv-alloc-rate, and p95 GC pause. Will update the ingest schema to accept residency hist buckets.

lisa: I'll build the sampling lib to roll up stack traces into a compact top-10 daily artifact. 1% sampling, dedupe by callsite hash.

emily: Risk notes / follow-ups: profiling is heavier — rate-limit sampling to 1% and throttle during peak; auto-delete S3 artifacts after 30d; include PR checklist item: "any per-request tail latency impact?"

sanjay: Adding lifecycle policy + kms key usage to proto. Will also include per-upload manifest for easy map-reduce.

kevin: After canary, capture GC pause metrics, p95 latency, and token-level cost differences. We'll reconvene with data next week for a short follow-up.

emily: Thanks all. I'll update the postmortem doc with owners, timeline, and links to the canary run + S3 bucket.

kevin: thx :thumbsup: 

emily: (closing) action tracker: https://redwood.internal/pm/2800012345-profiling-ownership
